observations: All strategies matched the corrected independent fresh-rebuild exact rank vector at all 1170 effective updates.

The V2 structural conclusion reproduces after fixing rank memoization: relative_2_0 lowers max allocated/live versus always_incremental in 12/12 new cells, with 39 trigger rebuilds plus 12 initialization rebuilds.

relative_2_0 and periodic_32 have similar median max ratios (7.60 vs 8.70) but relative_2_0 caps the worst observed ratio at 9.55 versus 15.10, while using 54013 vs 69291 cumulative nonterminal allocations. Corrected summed strategy time is 223.71 ms vs 250.69 ms in this run; cellwise runtime wins split 6/12.
relative_1_5 lowers stale-state proxies further (median/worst max ratio 6.59/8.72) but uses 73 trigger rebuilds, preserving the expected memory/rebuild tradeoff.
The 64-update hybrid backstop adds only two trigger rebuilds (41 vs 39) and leaves the worst max ratio unchanged; no clear structural advantage over pure relative_2_0 appears in this holdout.
always_incremental remains fastest in corrected summed time (209.11 ms) but has much larger stale-state ratios. Runtime and memory remain separate objectives; no scalar winner is declared.
